nuisance_policy: no posthoc nuisance refit; use released covariance blocks and declared nuisance treatment per block
covariance_policy: block_diagonal_initial_protocol: Pantheon full covariance + SDSS growth diagonal summary + SDSS multitracer 6x6 covariance; CMB safety is a support constraint not a likelihood
channel_amplitude_policy: single source-frozen void/web channel-amplitude grid shared across distance and growth blocks; no per-block residual tuning
unified_information_criterion: AIC_total = chi2_distance + chi2_growth + chi2_multitracer + 2*k_shared; report BIC_total as robustness when n_eff is declared
pass_condition_shell: candidate can be interpreted only if unified AIC improves over baseline, survives joint shuffled/wrong controls, remains stable under block-drop controls, preserves CMB-safety support, and uses no endpoint leakage fields
notes: This freezes the future combined void/web endpoint grammar. It does not compute a new likelihood, residual, information criterion, endpoint score, or validation result.
